headlines.description: AC Milan continued their unbeaten run in Serie A with a 1-1 draw against Sassuolo.
headlines.shortLinkText: Milan maintain unbeaten run with draw vs. Sassuolo

headlines.description: AC Milan held off a fightback from Atalanta to close out a 3-2 win at San Siro and move up into fourth in Serie A with manager Ruben Amorim remaining unbeaten in his first seven league games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Amorim still unbeaten in Serie A after Milan win
